data.name: Mahfuza

data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'hafaza', meaning to protect or guard. The name Mahfuza carries the meaning “Protected, Guarded” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahfuza usually hope their child will grow to embody protected, guarded and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Mahfuza signifies one who is under God's protection and care.
data.etymology: Mahfuza belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protected, Guarded.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahfuza total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: محفوظة
in_arabic.meaning: الله يحفظها، محمية ومحفوظة من كل سوء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل حفظ، يعني التي حفظها الله من كل مكروه وسوء، ويوحي بالحماية والرعاية الإلهية. ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الزمر آية ٥٦ 'وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ لَنُدْخِلَنَّهُم فِي الْجَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا أَبَدًا وَمَآوِيَهُمُ الْجَنَّاتُ وَجِزَاعُ الْخَشَبِ الَّذِي أَصْلُهُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَفَرُشِ الْمُخَضَّرَاتِ'

in_urdu.name: محفوظہ
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ کی حفاظت میں، محفوظ شدہ، سلامتی
in_urdu.long_meaning: عربی मूल کا ایک علم مؤنث نام، محفوظ کرنے کے فعل سے ماخوذ، معنیٰ اس کا یہ ہے کہ جسے اللہ نے اپنے شر سے محفوظ رکھا ہو، محفوظ شدہ، حفاظت شدہ، اور یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ اللہ کی قدرت و حفاظت کی نشانی ہے۔

in_hindi.meaning: भगवान की रक्षा में, सुरक्षित, संरक्षित

in_english.name: Mahfuza
in_english.meaning: Protected, preserved, one under God's safeguard
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mahfuza originates from Arabic, derived from the root 'hafaza,' meaning to protect or preserve. It signifies one who is protected by God, safeguarded from harm, and kept safe. This name holds spiritual significance in Islamic tradition, reflecting divine protection and care. Historically, it has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing a parent's prayer for their child's safety and well-being under God's protection.
